description: This Java source file defines the StylizeActivity class, which extends CameraActivity and implements OnImageAvailableListener. It involves capturing camera frames, applying neural style transfer using a TensorFlow model, and providing a user interface for selecting and adjusting artistic styles. The code manages image processing, TensorFlow inference, UI controls for style sliders, and saving stylized images.

classes.name: StylizeActivity
classes.description: Main activity for real-time stylization of camera input, managing TensorFlow inference and user interaction.

classes.name: ImageSlider
classes.description: Custom view representing a style slider in the UI.

classes.name: ImageGridAdapter
classes.description: Adapter providing UI components like sliders and buttons for style selection and image capture.

methods.description: Configures preview and stylization parameters once camera size is determined.

methods.name: stylizeImage
methods.description: Runs the TensorFlow model to stylize the input bitmap based on current style parameters.
